_doc: T-0839. The town cards ruled to be one person, as a LANDED ADJUDICATION the consolidation reads. consolidate_resident_evidence.py's declared_anchors() walks every *crosswalk*.json under data/research/ and moves each anchored appearance onto the identity that holds `person_id`, so the folded card's sources reach the survivor, the ladder regrades the joined identity, and mint_civic_residents.py refuses to re-mint a card whose identity now has a canonical person it does not own. DERIVED from the rulings and the redirect stubs — do not hand-edit.
